subject: Content-addressed resumable compiler symbol checkpoint
claim: Implementation commit 2cfd292202d2bbf0425b7457c6f94ada5dc81f9a preserves independently validated WVSS and WVSY bytes after a later analysis failure, reuses them only under their complete declared identity, and rejects corrupted symbol bytes without publishing final analysis output.

runs.target: Split-project development cache and ten-case internal sentinel

limitations: This is Windows-local development-cache evidence, not fresh compiler reconstruction or paired-host qualification.
The focused sentinel proves safe reuse and corruption rejection; it does not claim that cold analysis or emission is fast.
WVSY remains private resumable evidence and is excluded from the final analysis cache and distributable compiler products.
No source semantics, WVIR bytes, WVB bytes, runtime behavior, or native ABI contract changes because of this cache boundary.
